name: 選んだメッセージの一括操作バー
prompt:
Edit the first toolbar render to remove its excessive vertical padding and match the Japanese native preview. The target is a very short 390 × 72 px horizontal strip, 5.42:1, with the divider only near y=8 and the entire icon/text row centered around y=36. The first image placed the divider and controls too low; move them up so no large blank band remains above or below. The toolbar itself should occupy the frame, not float in a tall white poster.

Preserve the exact content and order: gray curved reply/back arrow at far left, centered bold dark `4件を選択`, gray outline trash icon near the right, gray outline share/send arrow at far right. Align all icons and the count to one horizontal centerline. Keep the thin light-gray top divider and white background from the native preview. No other icons, labels, or decoration.

The count is status text, not a hyperlink. Keep it dark and keep all icon strokes gray; no blue text. Use the 390 × 72 Japanese preview as the precise size and positioning reference, and use the first render only for icon shapes and copy. Crop away large empty areas in the composition so the visible toolbar is tight and compact.
reviewNotes: Correct Japanese copy and gray icon order; vertical placement still misses the 390x72 native preview after two attempts. No linked text.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
